Although we don’t yet have the details about the motives behind last night's shooting at the White House Correspondents Dinner, it’s incumbent upon all us to reject the idea that violence has any place in our democracy. It’s also a sobering reminder of the courage and sacrifice that U.S. Secret Service Agents show every day.

This video could be hours long instead of just 2 minutes… but it would be impossible to create a comparable version from the other side.

Just food for thought.

It’s completely understandable to be frustrated with the lack of conservatism on offense in Washington right now—it truly sucks to see the people we elected refuse to defund Planned Parenthood, introduce mass amnesty bills, continue funding the Taliban, ignore the SAVE America Act, etc.

But if you think the solution to change that is to suddenly vote for Democrats, I hope last night and the response to it was a wake up call.

Far too many on the Left don’t just want to beat conservative ideas.
